title: rosa communis var. eriostyla
intro: Rosa communis var. eriostyla, commonly known as the Wild Rose, is a type of flowering shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The Wild Rose is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to promote digestive health and reduce inflammation, making it beneficial for treating various gastrointestinal issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help protect against infections and alleviate symptoms associated with conditions such as ulcers and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Rosa communis var. eriostyla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
